basic_profile.bio: Joe is a 35-year-old tech enthusiast who resides in Austin, Texas. He works as a systems analyst for a mid-sized tech company. Joe is passionate about VR gaming, especially titles like Phasmophobia, and enjoys exploring new tech gadgets. When he's not gaming, Joe spends time reading about political ideologies and participating in discussions on LibertarianLeft. He's in a committed relationship and often games with his partner. Joe usually logs onto Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Joe has a solid foundation in technology and systems analysis, gained through his degree in Computer Science and several years of work experience in IT. He's self-taught in VR gaming and frequently updates himself with the latest gaming trends and tech news.
